title: Push step-count axis further: TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2^18->2^17
description: Halved TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2^18 to 2^17 (also halved DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 128->64 to keep tokens_per_fwdbwd dividing evenly, grad_accum_steps=1), doubling optimizer step count again within the fixed 5-min budget on top of ASPECT_RATIO=96/DEPTH=8/WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 baseline.
reflection: Strong, unambiguous win: val_bpb 0.978193 vs baseline 0.982306, a ~0.42% improvement well outside the cell's established ~0.02-0.03% noise band. The step-count axis (more/smaller optimizer steps) had only been tested at 2^19 (bad) and 2^18 (good) before this round -- pushing further in the winning direction paid off again, contradicting the assumption from round 3 messages that 2^18 was near a plateau. Also notable: this was the only proposal this round targeting the step-count axis (3 proposals converged on WEIGHT_DECAY=0.15, 2 on WARMDOWN_RATIO=0.7) -- picking the less-crowded, still-untested axis was the right call. Worth pushing even further next round (2^16) to see if the trend continues, though DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE will need to drop further too (to 32) which may start hurting gradient quality independent of step count -- that confound should be watched.
